name: Hada Dermatology
description: A calm block theme for a community dermatology clinic: a near-white ground with a pale grey band, ink text and one muted sage, Crimson Pro over Figtree. The home page opens on an inset photograph laid on an L-shaped band, a very thin oversized line crossing the photograph's lower edge, and hairline arcs; it continues with a signed letter from the founder, a numbered conditions index on a pastel gradient panel, three chapter bands, doctors as ruled rows, a waiting-room band, fees as ruled rows, the journal and booking. Sample content in English; inner pages and other languages follow. Works without any plugin.
